segments.name: Digital healthcare technology
segments.description: Provides life sciences brands tech-enabled HCP and consumer marketing, audience activation and financial messaging through an omnichannel network embedded in EHR and eRx platforms.
segments.evidence: We operate in one reportable segment and use consolidated net income (loss) as our measure of segment profit and loss.

revenueModel.text: Life sciences brand customers and their agency partners pay for tech-enabled marketing solutions, audience targeting and media execution reaching healthcare providers and patients.
revenueModel.evidence: Customers are able to execute traditional marketing campaigns utilizing our proprietary digital point-of-care network, as well as dynamic DTC marketing campaigns that optimize audiences in real time to increase the value of treatment information for HCPs and patients.
